purpose: improve small road-object detection using fixed multi-view inference with existing pinned YOLOX-S
views: full image, then up to3 squares of side min(width,height), at long-axis offsets0,floor((long-short)/2),long-short; remove duplicate rectangles; at most4 passes
crop_filter: reject boxes within1 source pixel of an interior crop edge; full-image view and exterior image edges retained
merge: restore global pixel coordinates with f32; stable confidence descending,class ascending,left ascending,view index,local rank; classwise IoU strictly above .45 suppresses; global cap300 and at most1200 input boxes
boundaries: existing16M decoded pixels/16MiB encoded input; pinned35,858,002-byte model; one reused CPU plan; no threshold or label-based tile tuning

evaluation.viewed_records: all8 already viewed original BDD frames and138 references; all misses/FP retained, exact original class mapping and licence
evaluation.calibration: report fixed5-bin reliability and Brier on scoped predictions; no fit or calibrated-probability claim
evaluation.data_role: development regression; new heldout protocol only after this fixed gate

goal: toward30% overall maturity; this stage alone cannot establish it
